description: This file implements the SystemTime class, which manages system time synchronization, timezone parsing, event handling, and interaction with a remote JSON-RPC service for time updates within the WPEFramework plugin architecture.

classes.name: SystemTime
classes.description: A class that manages system time synchronization, timezone information, and event handling for time updates via JSON-RPC within the WPEFramework plugin.

methods.name: SystemTime
methods.description: Constructor initializing the SystemTime object, starting the event loop thread, and pushing an initialization event.

methods.name: ~SystemTime
methods.description: Destructor that signals shutdown, joins the event thread, and cleans up subscriptions.

methods.name: IsSystemTimeAvailable
methods.description: Returns whether the system time is currently available and synchronized.

methods.name: GetTimeZoneOffset
methods.description: Retrieves the current timezone offset in seconds and its accuracy.

methods.name: onTimeStatusChanged
methods.description: Callback invoked when the time status changes, enqueues an event for processing.

methods.name: onTimeZoneDSTChanged
methods.description: Callback invoked when the timezone or DST status changes, enqueues an event for processing.

methods.name: CreateSystemLink
methods.description: Establishes a JSON-RPC link to the system service, including security token generation.

methods.name: SubscribeForEvents
methods.description: Subscribes to time status and timezone change events via JSON-RPC.

methods.name: UpdateTimeStatus
methods.description: Queries the current time status from the system service and updates internal state.

methods.name: UpdateTimeZone
methods.description: Queries the current timezone and accuracy, updating internal state and transition map.

methods.name: ParseTimeZone
methods.description: Parses the timezone string and transition map to determine current offset and accuracy.

methods.name: PopulateTimeZoneTransitionMap
methods.description: Populates the transition map by parsing the output of 'zdump' for the current timezone.

methods.name: EventLoop
methods.description: Main loop processing queued events such as initialization, time status updates, timezone updates, and shutdown.
